questions.question:
In the following question, select the related letters from the given alternatives.

DJLQ : WQOJ : : DMSW : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

DJLQ : WQOJ

D – 4 (from A to Z) = W – 4 (from Z to A)

J – 10 (from A to Z) = Q – 10 (from Z to A)

L – 12 (from A to Z) = O – 12 (from Z to A)

Q – 17 (from A to Z) = Q – 17 (from Z to A)

DMSW : ?

D – 4 (from A to Z) = W – 4 (from Z to A)

M – 14 (from A to Z) = N – 14 (from Z to A)

S – 8 (from A to Z) = H – 8 (from Z to A)

W – 4 (from A to Z) = D – 4 (from Z to A)

Hence, answer is WNHD.

questions.question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

A, E, J, N, S, W, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

A + 4 = E

E + 5 = J

J + 4 = N

N + 5 = S

S + 4 = W

Hence, W + 5 = B

Hence, answer is B.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

3, 7, 16, 35, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is:

3 × 2 + 1 = 7

7 × 2 + 2 = 16

16 × 2 + 3 = 35

35 × 2 + 4 = **74**

Hence, the missing figure is 74.

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of L and N is 7 : 5. If the age of N after seven years will be 32 years, what is the present age (in years) of L?
questions.solution:
Let the present ages of L and N be 7x and 5x respectively.

The age of N after seven years will be 32 years i.e.

5x + 7 = 32

5x = 32 - 7

5x = 25

x = 5

The present age of L = 7x = 7 × 5 = 35

Hence, answer is 35.

questions.question:
In the following question, from the given alternative words, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word.

Nightwalker
questions.solution:
1) Talker - NIGH**T**W**ALKER** - can be formed.

2) Tailer - N**I**GH**T**W**AL**K**ER** - can be formed.

3) Waller - NIGHTWALKER - cannot be formed as there is only one L.

4) Winer - **NI**GHT**W**ALK**ER **- can be formed.

Hence, Waller cannot be formed using the letters of Nightwalker.

questions.question:
In each of the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some cups are plates.

II. All spoons are blue.

III. No plates are spoon.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cups are not spoon.

II. Some plates are not blue.

III. Some cups are not blue.

IV. Some blue are not plates.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram of the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92b7aa7f4a5fc36b0a5c4f26d61c885b8e05fbc980099d96226d501e7e13ec43.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cups are not spoon. - True (As Some cups are plates and No plates are spoon. So, the conclusion is definite true. )

II. Some plates are not blue. - False (It is possible but not definite)

III. Some cups are not blue. - False (As there is not any direct relation between cups and blue. It is possible but not definite)

IV. Some blue are not plates. - True (As Spoons are not plates, so, Some blue are not plates is definite true)

Hence, only conclusion (I) and (IV) follow.
